test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Swaran Singh committee had formulated ________-point code of fundamental duties.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8-point code of fundamental duties**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was appointed by the Government of India in 1976 to make recommendations for fundamental duties of citizens.
 
• The committee recommended an **8-point code of fundamental duties** to be included in the Constitution of India.
 
• These duties were intended to serve as a constant reminder to every citizen that while enjoying their rights, they also have a duty to observe certain basic norms of democratic conduct and behavior.
 
• The recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee were incorporated into the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The fundamental duties are enshrined in Part IV-A of the Constitution of India under Article 51A.
 
• Initially, ten fundamental duties were added, but later an eleventh duty was added by the 86th Amendment Act, 2002.
 
• These duties are moral obligations of all citizens to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India.
 
• Unlike fundamental rights, fundamental duties are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by the courts for their violation.
